# AI-QA project guidance template

> Inert source template. Configure renders `.github/instructions/qa-project.instructions.md`
> in the target project only after a specific L5 preview and approval. Choose a
> deliberate project-file glob; do not leave a placeholder in active instructions.

<!-- ai-qa:managed:start -->
- Use `.github/ai-qa/project/project.md` and applicable
  `.github/ai-qa/project/conventions/*.md` for confirmed project facts.
